derivations.quote: the phase frame is $\mathcal C_U=H^{\otimes m}\operatorname{diag}_x(i^{q_U(x)})H^{\otimes m}$, with Gaussian-dyadic entries.
Over the network the number of translation-kernel factors is $s_{\rm c}=W_{\rm c}m-2N+2L_{\rm c}=1873807244636671267308000000<W_{\rm c}m$.
If $z\cdot w=0$ the intersection cardinality is even, so weight is additive modulo four on orthogonal vectors.
so $q_V(x)-q_U(x)=\sum_{v\in\mathcal B}\operatorname{wt}(v)[v\cdot x]\pmod 4$, negated on a decreasing edge, and each $\operatorname{wt}(v)$ is odd.
The function $i^{\varepsilon[v\cdot x]}$ with $\varepsilon=\pm1$ equals $\frac{1+i^\varepsilon}2+\frac{1-i^\varepsilon}2(-1)^{v\cdot x}$.
Since $H\operatorname{diag}(1,-1)H=X$, the character $(-1)^{v\cdot x}$ becomes the translation $X_v$, so the phase becomes $aI+bX_v$ or its inverse ($\varepsilon=-1$).
The deficit of $s_{\rm c}$ from $W_{\rm c}m$ is $2N-2L_{\rm c}>0$.

Orthogonal additivity gives $\operatorname{wt}(x)-2\operatorname{wt}(u)[u\cdot x]$, and $27$ is odd, so $q_{U_a^\perp}-q_{U_a}=\operatorname{wt}(x)+2[u\cdot x]\pmod 4$, so the operator is $C^{-1}$ on the 27 coordinates of $\operatorname{supp}(u)$ and $C$ elsewhere.

The identity $C=iZC^{-1}Z$ turns each of the $27k$ inverse factors into $C$ after applying $Z_{a,k}$ before and $i^{27k}Z_{a,k}$ after, so every role, scratch roles included, receives $C^{\otimes mk}$.
